name: qcom-cpucp-scmi
scope: canoe CPU DVFS transport: qcom_cpucp mailbox, qcom SCMI vendor protocol + client, cpucp_fast, cpucp_log, cpu_phys_log_map, qcom-cpufreq-hw (clk-scmi replaced by the 7.3 in-tree scmi-clk)
reviewed_changes: qcom_scmi_vendor: 7.3 removed xops->version_get; version comes from ph->version; supported_version=UINT_MAX keeps 6.12 behaviour (no NEGOTIATE_PROTOCOL_VERSION to vendor firmware)

qcom-cpufreq-hw: boost via .set_boost=cpufreq_boost_set_sw (cpufreq_enable_boost_support/policy_has_boost_freq removed in 7.x); no explicit scaling_*_freqs attrs (core adds them, no longer exported); .remove_new -> .remove
-DCONFIG_QTI_QCOM_SCMI_CLIENT_MODULE so qcom_scmi_vendor.h declares the client API; WALT defines for cpucp_fast
vendor clk-scmi.c is an older upstream copy than GKI 6.12: dropped in favour of CONFIG_COMMON_CLK_SCMI=m (scmi-clk.ko)
DT: arm,max-msg-size=<128> on /soc/qcom,cpucp-scmi (ports/device-tree/avr73-fixups.dtso); 7.3 mailbox default 104 makes vendor 128-byte requests fail with -ERANGE
core: patches/scmi-boost-7.3.patch (boost default on as GKI 6.12; cpufreq_boost_set_sw can lower the limit again)
